'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Andrew Moss DS Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Moss]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Galen, Secret Apprentice (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed)|OVS17-13-Galen_Secret_Apprentice-remaster.webp|label=Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Parry and Thrust
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
